concerns.text: User Story 1 requires ≥ 15 validated CBC injection events (FR‑001) but the integration test in T015 only checks for ≥ 5 entries, weakening the acceptance criterion.

FR‑007 and Constitution Principle VII mandate LALInference CPU‑mode parameter estimation; T022 implements a Bilby/Dynesty “Fast PE” wrapper, which is a prohibited substitution and thus violates the specification and constitution.

The spec requires hierarchical Bayesian shift tests using KL divergence (FR‑007). T024 performs credible‑interval overlap and falls back to paired t‑tests, omitting KL divergence and weakening the statistical validation.
FR‑010 demands creation of an external “Bias_Original” baseline artifact, but no task in the list generates or records this baseline, leaving the requirement unmet.

SC‑002 specifies that compression levels with SNR degradation > 5 % must be flagged as unacceptable. While T020 mentions flagging, the accompanying test T021 only asserts SNR > 0, providing no verification of the 5 % threshold.

Using Bilby instead of LALInference directly contravenes Constitution Principle VII (Parameter‑Estimation Integrity), which explicitly forbids alternative pipelines without explicit justification and provenance.
